whatsappMessage:
Hi Bhagalpur Dental Clinic,

I noticed your clinic has exceptional 5.0★ ratings from over 200 patients in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct online appointment bookings.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, painless dental treatments, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bhagalpurdental

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Bhagalpur Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with your 5.0★ patient trust and direct WhatsApp appointment booking for Boring Road patients. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
